apps.title: Countdown Timer
apps.description: A countdown timer built for focus. Pick a duration or a target time and the clock takes over the screen, with a looping cinematic scene behind it — a lake at dawn, rain, embers. Scenes reframe themselves for portrait, and reduced-motion settings get a still instead. Sessions are kept locally, and any setup shares as a link.

apps.title: Hat
apps.description: A random picker for when something just needs choosing. Drop in names, numbers or emoji, then pull one out of the hat. Recent pulls stay on screen so you can see what has already come up, and the whole setup shares as a link so everyone draws from the same hat.

apps.title: Weather
apps.description: A dense, chart-first weather dashboard. Hourly and daily forecasts, wind, pressure, UV and air quality for anywhere you search — no accounts, no ads, no location prompt unless you ask for it.

apps.title: Mad Lib
apps.description: A story generator you fill in yourself. Pick a tale, supply the words, watch it fall apart.

apps.title: Hush
apps.description: A classroom noise meter. A colourful dial shows the room how loud it is, and speaks up when it stays too loud.

apps.title: Runify
apps.description: A running route planner and run analyser in one page. Draw a route on real paths, see what the hills cost, then drop in a GPX and read back what happened.

apps.title: Linkit
apps.description: An anonymous, community-run board of links worth keeping. Post what you find, vote on what others post, and let the downvotes do the pruning.
